svg.title: How Kasir POS is built
svg.desc: People: Cashier and staff, Guest. App: Web app, API. Agents: AI agent, MCP server. Data: PostgreSQL, AgentBuff login. Docker Compose on a VPS: database, API and static web server on an internal network behind a reverse proxy, with daily backups.
svg.text: The main parts and how data moves between them.
